Question Choices: Two lights flash every 14 and 21 seconds. They flash together now. In how many seconds will they next flash together?
Hints: Use the largest exponent of each prime that occurs in any of the numbers.
Solution: 14 = 2*7; 21 = 3*7. Taking each prime with its largest exponent gives LCM = 42.
